name: Trexo Robotics
brief:
Product: Trexo Robotics
One-liner: Exoskeletons to help people walk, starting with children
Description: Trexo Robotics is building exoskeletons to help people walk, starting with children. Our product allows children with disabilities like Cerebral Palsy, to walk, in many cases for the first time in their lives. Trexo was started when Manmeet found that his nephew was born with Cerebral Palsy and would never be able to walk. Trexo is selling commercially, with a vision is to replace the wheelchair, for children, adults, and the elderly.
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Devices
Tags: Medical Robotics
target:
Exoskeletons to help children walk.

Now FDA cleared

Because for a child, walking is more than getting around.

What Trexo Theo is

Active, over-ground walking. The movement growing bodies are built for.

Trexo Theo is a wearable robotic exoskeleton that moves a child's legs through a real gait cycle, over the ground, at their own pace.

One device, fitted to your child, used at home, outdoors and in clinic.

Every step is intentional

The lights tell you what the robot is feeling.

Clinical evidence

Studied at home and in clinic.

Published research on how families and clinics use Trexo.

participants enrolled

Six months of home and community use.

Researchers followed 171 children and young adults whose families had obtained a Trexo, tracking device use month by month and parent-reported outcomes over six months.

Observational cohort · 171 enrolled

Hilderley et al., 2025 · J NeuroEng Rehabil

min/week, median

Regular walking in a family-led program.

Fifteen completers in a 12-week program walked a median 150 minutes and five sessions per week. Eight of the 15 met the weekly target on average.

Single-group feasibility study · 19 enrolled, 15 completed

Youngblood et al., 2026 · Disabil Rehabil

of walking time, median

Activity measured during a session.

In 15 participants, a median 99% of robotic walking time met the study’s heart-rate threshold for physical activity, consistent with at least light activity.

Single-session study · 15 participants · activity measured during use

Youngblood et al., 2025 · J Phys Act Health

Steps around the Earth

Steps taken in a Trexo. Around the Earth , three times over and counting.

Steps aren't just distance. They're dose.

Updated live from the Trexo fleet. One trip around the Earth is measured along the equator: about 50 million steps.

Built with clinicians.

Every session records steps, speed and assistance, so over-ground gait training becomes something you can track, adjust and document. One device serves a caseload across four sizes and the full range of support.

Patients 12 years and older with cerebral palsy

Clinic and community

Certified therapist or companion

Steps and settings recorded every session

Why we built it

Manmeet Maggu and his nephew Praneit, the inspiration behind Trexo.

“Watching Praneit take his first steps using our device was an incredibly proud moment for us.”

name: Duckie
brief:
Product: Duckie
One-liner: Build AI Support Agents in Minutes
Description: Duckie lets customer support teams build their own AI agents in minutes! With Duckie, support teams can translate their tasks and processes into predictable and reliable AI workflows that saves them time and money. Folks use Duckie to handle a wide range of use cases, from answers customers technical questions to processing refunds, and everything in between.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Customer Support, Operations, AI
target:
The agentic platform for support teams

Support teams become AI builders, shipping agents that resolve tickets, investigate issues, and automate any workflow behind support.

Anyone can hop on Claude and try to build a chatbot. But to build one that's actually a full system like this? I don't think that's realistic as a one-man job at home.

Managing the support team used to be about managing humans. Now it's about being someone who can manage an AI system.

Being able to use the assistant to create things like runbooks, guidelines, and guardrails, and troubleshoot specific runs has made things quite a bit easier.

We had three support people. Now we have one, and we're handling 30% more tickets than last year.

AI-first support teams build on Duckie

From resolving tickets to investigating issues and triaging escalations, build an agent for any part of the job.

What teams build on Duckie

From complex financial workflows to onboarding, technical troubleshooting, and compliance — real teams building far beyond ticket deflection.

Automated their most complex financial-services workflows . Duckie walks each member's full ledger, runs branching cancellations, and reads Grid's backend live — resolving the edge cases that used to live only in an operator's memory.

What do you want to build?

Every frontier model, switch whenever you want

Wired into all your tools and data

Centralized agent management

Orchestrate agents on one canvas

Everything you need to make AI production ready

Point Duckie at your tools and say what should happen — in plain English.

“When a customer asks to cancel, check their plan in Stripe, offer a retention discount, then update the subscription.”

You know how support should work. Now you can build it.

name: Molagri
brief:
Product: Molagri
One-liner: Resistance free pesticides.
Description: Molagri develops safer, more effective pesticides for agriculture. We design biopesticides that hit a precise molecular target unique to pest insects, knocking out pests while sparing pollinators, beneficial insects, and the wider ecosystem. By modeling how pests are likely to evolve, we stay a step ahead of resistance, keeping our products effective against the pests of today and tomorrow.
Industry: Industrials / Agriculture
Tags: Synthetic Biology, Biotech, Sustainability, Climate, Agriculture
target:
Engineering biology into precise crop protection

Resistance is making today’s crop protection less effective, while regulations keep removing existing solutions.

Engineered on biology’s own blueprints

Genetic Payload

Once inside, the VLP delivers genetic instructions to the insect’s own cells. These cells then produce a species-specific toxin, which is released into the bloodstream and eliminates the target pest.

Target Recognition

Our VLPs are designed to recognize unique receptors found only in the gut of a specific pest. This allows them to enter the gut cells of that species while leaving other insects unaffected.

A platform, not a product

Designed for commercial production using scalable fermentation and a modular architecture that can be adapted across different insect pests.

No need for redesigning technology as the agricultural challenges evolve.

Species-specific targeting

Precision biological payloads

Modular product development

Scale-ready manufacturing

Built to tackle resistance head-on

Built for the people moving agriculture forward

A differentiated platform designed to solve today's agricultural challenges.

Bringing biomedical engineering into agriculture.

Better tools for today's crop protection challenges.

Care built into the science

Understanding comes first

Better crop protection starts with understanding biology, then engineering it with precision.

Science should solve real problems

Science creates impact only when it reaches the field and solves real agricultural challenges.

Precision is a responsibility

The more precisely we solve the problem, the less unnecessary impact and waste we create.

Great science starts with purpose-driven people

We come from structural biology and protein biochemistry, and we're bringing that expertise to agriculture. We care about the science, and about building a place where people are respected and do their best work.

Zaky Hassan

Zaky is a protein biochemist and viral structural biologist who has characterized mechanisms of antibody neutralization in human pathogenic coronaviruses. He has an undergraduate degree in Biochemistry (Honours BSc) and graduate training in Biochemistry (PhD candidate) from the University of Toronto. He was awarded $130K+ in fellowships, and published twice in Nature Communications.

Min Jin

Min is a viral structural biologist and protein biochemist, and the current world record holder for the highest resolution structure of a coronavirus spike protein in the Protein Data Bank (1.68 Angstrom). She has an undergraduate degree in Biophysics (Honours BSc) and graduate training in Biochemistry (PhD candidate) from the University of Toronto and she has published in Nature Microbiology and Nature Communications.

Be part of the next chapter in crop protection

name: Rank (formerly Moni)
brief:
Product: Rank (formerly Moni)
One-liner: Group Financing for small businesses across Africa.
Description: Moni finances small businesses in groups across Africa. The collective responsibility of the group serves as a collateral on the loan while the social pressure from the members ensures on-time repayment. There are over 44million SMBs in Africa. We launched 7 months ago and we already have $72k MRR growing at 50% MoM. We achieved 99% repayment on 11,000 units of loans with over $5M disbursed. This is 15 times higher than most financial services in Africa.

Tags: Banking as a Service, Fintech, Neobank
target:

Get the app

Access investments and savings with expert human guidance reserved for the ultra-wealthy. Rank gives you this access through the power of people.

You deserve to be wealthy. You've saved for years. Stayed disciplined. Yet the gates to real wealth still feel closed. We break the lock. Rank turns your network into your net worth—giving you access to capital through connection, without debt traps.

name: Rima AI (formerly Garage)
brief:
Product: Rima AI (formerly Garage)
One-liner: Document and spreadsheet automation for accountants
Description: Rima helps accountants automate document and spreadsheet work with accuracy and cell-level audit tracking. For accountants that deal with messy docs and spend their time in Excel, Rima enables them to build workflows in natural language to extract and process financial data from PDFs or ERPs into their Excel templates and reconcile their spreadsheets in minutes.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Finance, B2B, Analytics
target:
AI for Tax Resolution Firms

Domain specific AI for tax resolution firms and EAs that automates manual case prep end to end.

Supports 433-F · 433-B · 433-A (OIC)

Modern Tax Resolution Runs on Rima

Rima helps case managers and EAs automate data entry, case completeness checklist and research so they can focus on review

Advisor

Instantly search through case documents to surface advocacy angles and get full case summaries before going into any meeting. No more hunting through pages or losing hours on research.

Data Entry

Upload structured and unstructured documents like Bank statements, tax transcripts, loan statements, utility bills, intake forms, etc. Rima data entry agent reads every page and populates the 433-F, 433-B, or 433-A (OIC) forms using your unique rules and edge case exceptions. Say goodbye to manual data entry and data transfer.

Case Completeness Checklist

Build automated checklists to review every case for missing documents, incomplete fields, and low-confidence data. See what needs attention and resolve all issues before submission.

Actual $46,155 exceeds IRS local standard $1,958 by $44,197; supporting documentation required

Health insurance not found in QA/PFQ and no usable pay-stub backup available

State tax could not be determined and set to $0

Workflows

A complete library of tax resolution workflows, covering everything from 433 forms to 1040 preparation and P&L reporting. Standardize case prep across your firm to improve speed, accuracy, and consistency.

Human-in-the-Loop

Every task completed by Rima agents is reviewed by humans. Rima flags missing information and low-confidence data, letting your enrolled agents and case managers review and approve everything before it's finalized.

Tasks

Runs waiting on your review — approve extractions and write-backs to let them continue.

Integrations

Seamlessly sync client data, documents, and completed forms back to your existing practice management tools. No more double data entry or scattered files.

Integrations to your CRM, document & practice management software

AI Assisted Tax Resolution That Empowers Your Team To Do More

Prep time

2 hrs → 30 mins

Per IRS form, prepped — down from two hours of manual entry

Tax resolution cases completed on Rima

FULLY OPTIMIZED WORKFLOWS

Fully optimized workflows: 433-F, 433-OIC, 433-B, 1040

Rima AI reduces manual data entry, enhances review to ensure case completeness and accelerates operations at scale.

Your Data and Knowledge Stay Secure

Security built around client financial data.

Every layer of Rima is designed to handle and protect your most sensitive data.

Move your team from data entry to case review.

name: Finlens
brief:
Product: Finlens
One-liner: AI Accounting for Founders & Accountants
Description: Finlens is an AI co-pilot for QuickBooks, built for founders and accounting firms who want faster closes, real-time visibility, and clean books without the spreadsheet chaos. We automate categorisation, GAAP schedules, and collaboration, all on top of your existing QuickBooks setup. No migrations. No change management. Just a smarter way to work with the stack you already use. Backed by Y Combinator (W20) and Accel.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: SaaS, Finance, B2B, AI
target:
Add more clients without adding headcount.

Finlens automates the manual work your team still does by hand. Stripe RevRec, onboarding, prepaid schedules, categorization. All synced back to QuickBooks

Integrations

From bank feed to closed books.

Connect once, then let Finlens do the heavy lifting. Your team reviews, approves, and closes faster — every client, every month.

Link QuickBooks Online and your clients' bank, card, and payment feeds in minutes. Finlens imports the full history and keeps every transaction flowing in automatically. No CSV wrangling.

Finlens categorizes every transaction, pulls data from bills and receipts, and drafts your journal entries and accruals. Each one gets a confidence score, so your team knows what to trust and what to check.

High-confidence work clears on its own. Only the exceptions reach your accountants. One-click approval, a category dropdown mapped to your QBO chart of accounts, and a full audit trail on every decision.

Reviewed entries post straight to QBO, mapped to the right accounts, with reconciliation done before you even open QuickBooks. Two-way sync keeps your books and Finlens identical. No double entry, no drift.

Track every task across every client, see where the time goes, and act on what needs attention. Books closed in days, not weeks. Month after month.

Your team is buried in month-end. Every month.

The same manual work. The same bottlenecks. The same late nights. It doesn't have to be this way.

Reconciliation is a time sink

Hours spent matching transactions, chasing exceptions, and fixing miscategorized entries — every single month, for every single client.

Checklists live in spreadsheets

Close tasks are tracked in Google Sheets or email threads. One missed step means a delayed close or a client restatement.

Errors surface too late

By the time someone catches a posting error, it's already in the client's books. Fixing it means more time, more back-and-forth, more risk.

Close the books in days, not weeks.

From raw transactions to client-ready financials — automated. Six steps, one platform, every month.

AI categorizes every transaction automatically

Connect your QBO and Finlens immediately starts categorizing transactions with AI — across every bank account, card, and data source your clients use.

Bills, invoices & receipts — extracted automatically. No Dext needed.

Finlens pulls documents straight from your email or bulk uploads, extracts every field with AI, maps to your chart of accounts, and posts the journal entry to QBO. One less tool. One less bill.
